name: Customers Bancorp, Inc.
summary: Customers Bancorp, Inc. operates as the bank holding company for Customers Bank that provides banking products and services for commercial and consumer clients. It accepts various deposit banking products, including commercial and consumer checking accounts, non-interest-bearing and interest-bearing demand accounts, MMDA, savings accounts, and time deposit accounts.
